info.name: User Management APIs
info.description:
End-to-end API collection: Auth, Users, Profiles, Clients, Projects, Project Tasks, My Tasks, Task Comments and Role-Based Permission tests.

SETUP: (1) Login as Admin (folder 1). (2) Create Developer, Manager and Team Leader users (folder 2). (3) Run the 3 role logins in folder 1 - they save manager_token / team_leader_token / developer_token. (4) Set project_id (collection variable) to a project that has a date_of_completion.

ID variables task_id, comment_id, dev_comment_id are saved automatically by the create requests.

FILE UPLOAD: file rows are disabled by default. Tick the row, click 'Select Files', pick a real file (not a folder).

request.description: Your Admin / Super Admin account. Saves access_token.
Create the Manager user first (Users folder). Default password = <email prefix>@123.
Create the Team Leader user first (Users folder). Default password = <email prefix>@123.
Create the Developer user first (Users folder). Default password = <email prefix>@123.

profiles is REQUIRED (case-insensitive). Login password = rahul.sharma@123. Needs the Admin token (access_token): only Super Admin / Admin / Human Resource can create users once role-based permissions are on.

'manager' -> 'Manager'. Login password = manager.test@123. Use this user as assigned_manager. Needs the Admin token (access_token): only Super Admin / Admin / Human Resource can create users once role-based permissions are on.

Login password = tl.test@123. Team Leaders can create tasks and be assigned tasks. Needs the Admin token (access_token): only Super Admin / Admin / Human Resource can create users once role-based permissions are on.
If the profile name does not exist, a new (non-default, deletable) profile is created automatically.
Expect 400: Profile is required.
Expect 400: Profile cannot be blank.
Saves modified_by + modified_at.
Records deleted_by + deleted_at. Use Restore User below to bring it back.
Second call returns 400 'already active'.
Second call returns 400 'already inactive'.
PUT (not POST). Works only on a soft-deleted user. The user who restored is saved in modified_by.
Searches name / email / username / phone. Multi-word search works too, e.g. 'rahul sharma'.
Users have 'nationality' (not 'country'). Clients have 'countries' and use ?country=.
Check is_default: true for the 6 default profiles: Super Admin, Admin, Manager, Team Leader, Developer, Human Resource.

item.name: Create Profile - Duplicate Name Different Case (400)

request.description: Names are unique case-insensitively: 'admin' is rejected when 'Admin' exists.
Change the id to one of YOUR custom profiles (non-default). Default profiles return 403.
Use the id of a default profile. Default profiles cannot be edited. Expect 403.
Use the id of a default profile. Expect 403.

request.description: Use the id of a profile YOU created. Users having it will get profiles = null.
Works only on a soft-deleted client. Saves restored_by + restored_at.
email_id is unique. Run after 'Create Client (Success)'.
PUT works like PATCH. Saves updated_by.
Use the email_id of ANOTHER existing client. Expect 400.

item.name: Soft Delete Client - Not Found / Already Deleted (404)

request.description: Use an ACTIVE client id. Expect 400 'already active'.
Use an INACTIVE client id. Expect 400 'already inactive'.
List shows attachments_count and tasks_count.
Only projects that have at least one active task.

request.description: Projects where user 26 has at least one active task.

item.name: 6. Project Tasks
item.description: Before this folder: (1) create Manager, Team Leader and Developer users, (2) run the 3 role logins in folder 1, (3) set the collection variable project_id to a project whose date_of_completion is 2026-12-31 or later. The Admin token cannot create tasks (only Manager / Team Leader).

request.description: POST /projects/<id>/tasks/. The project comes from the URL. Status becomes Pending automatically. assigned_to accepts user id or email. Saves the new id in {{task_id}}.
Change 26 to the id of your Developer / Team Leader user.

item.name: Create Task - 'status' in body is ignored (still Pending)

request.description: Even if status=Completed is sent, a new task is always Pending.

item.name: Create Task - Assign to Team Leader (201)

request.description: Only Manager / Team Leader can create tasks.
Admin token (access_token) is not Manager / Team Leader, so 403.

request.description: Rule: start_date <= deadline_date <= project date_of_completion.
